title: Substitution tied to the selected reindexing systems
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite and $g:X\xrightarrow{\sim}Y$ with $\ell$ invertible where constructibility is used. Use [def-pod-completion-tensor-normalization] [lem-pur-completed-operation-tower-substitution]. For selected D,T choose a completed-operation model on the two locations Y,X. Require its calculi, completion comparisons, Roos models and g-pullback realization to be exactly those of D and retain tensor transports qY,qX from the global Roos tensor to the slice tensor, each uniquely fixed by requiring its composite with the model tensor realization and the canonical codomain comparison to equal the prescribed full strict-tower realization. The codomain comparison uses [lem-coef-closed-tensor-comparison]: it is the closed-tensor comparison through the common internal Hom, followed by the unique comparison of the reduction left adjoints to the common total-limit functor. On every normalized input system require the primitive pullback comparison, preceded by D's ordinary-to-completed map, to equal D.limit. Require T's Roos/canonical normalization and the comparison, simultaneous-substitution and structural laws on this same model. This defines a predicate, not a theorem about unrelated systems.
